name: recommendation-card
title: Recommendation Card
summary: A suggestion from an agent with its confidence, the action to take and the alternatives.
description: A suggestion from the agent with its confidence, the action to take and the alternatives it weighed. The card holds its shape: every option's body shares one cell, so switching crossfades in place. Alternatives reveals a drawer of the other options, picking one promotes it, and the primary action confirms and turns into Accepted.

anatomy.description: The root of a collapsible (Zag): data-state=open|closed from the engine
role=status, sr-only; says the accepted label once accepted
one grid cell holding every option's body, so the card is as tall as the longest
one option's body; data-active on the shown one, aria-hidden on the rest; may contain EntityChip / ValuePill
The collapsible’s region (collapsible-content > collapsible-body, the reveal recipe), marked data-recommendation-card="drawer": hidden while closed, instant from the keyboard. Absent with one option
the alternatives' one glide layer (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`), first child of the drawer list, aria-hidden; follows hover and focus
one per option; the active option's row is hidden
3 bars on one baseline; data-tone; aria-hidden (the label says it)
An outline sm Button, Alternatives (the collapsible's trigger: aria-expanded, aria-controls; absent with one option) + the option's primary action

items.body: string | segment[] (string, { entity, color? }, { value, tone? }, { strong })
items.label: string

options.description: The options; with one option there is no Alternatives button and no drawer.

open.description: The drawer is open (ignored with one option).

keyboard: Alternatives: Enter / Space toggle the drawer at once; focus stays on the button (aria-expanded, aria-controls)
The drawer sits above the footer, so its rows come before Alternatives in the tab order (Shift+Tab from Alternatives reaches them)
Each alternative is a button: Enter / Space promote it; focus stays at the same place in the list
The primary action: Enter / Space accept
notes: The closed drawer is hidden, so its rows are not in the tab order. With one option there is no Alternatives button and no drawer.
Inactive bodies are aria-hidden; the meter is aria-hidden next to its text label.
Accepting announces the accepted label through role=status.

motion: body: crossfade between options, opacity + blur(2px) over duration.base (transition, so rapid picks retarget; the stacked cell keeps the height)
drawer: the collapsible's reveal recipe (grid-template-rows over duration.reveal easing.out-strong, opacity over duration.base); the footer moves with it; instant from the keyboard
alt rows: one highlight glides between them on hover and focus (transform + height over duration.move, easing.out-strong; fades in over duration.base); :active hover-2 over duration.fast
primary action: the button's own colour transition into success
